source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将明，静压将翻
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC31 after EP02 SC30 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where concealment can barely still function into the next brink: Keshadu's private certainty is almost public, Shisilang's fury threatens a true break in order, Tuobaye is almost drained dry, and the white-clothed woman's restraint feels ready to overturn into unmistakable intervention.
title: 真相将明，静压将翻

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC30 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC30 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将出，十四郎几近失手，拓拔野余力将尽，白衣女子的静压已到难存边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推到几乎真正翻面的边缘。科沙度的判断已经几乎无法回收，十四郎的失控也快撕碎表面的秩序，拓拔野只剩最后一点硬撑。白衣女子的克制则来到几乎不再可能继续维持的最后一瞬。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线压迫推进到真正即将不可逆出手或揭露的门前，为后面的明确爆点做最后蓄压。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled until the true source beat finally forces the turn; avoid fake spectacle before the actual break.
Keshadu should feel like he is effectively already certain.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to a real mistake.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: near-public truth, collapsing order, spent endurance, and turning restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
